messages.app.title: Silver-Scale Atelier · Theme Manager
messages.app.subtitle: Desktop themes and characters · Beta
messages.app.support: Windows x64; only the listed exact Store client versions are candidates. Sign-in and chat require internet access.
messages.app.closeHint: Closing this window stops the theme connection; the official client stays open.
messages.app.modeHint: Home and chat share settings. Focus mode hides decorations and keeps your selection.
messages.app.alreadyOpen: The manager is already open. Use its existing window.
messages.app.failed: The manager operation failed. Keep the diagnostics and retry; the official client was not closed.
messages.status.noClient: No supported official client was found; the manager can still run.
messages.status.supported: Candidate version; real-client verification is still required
messages.status.unsupported: This version is unverified; loading is blocked
messages.status.resourcesReady: Original character and atelier assets verified
messages.status.resourcesMissing: Assets are unavailable or failed verification
messages.status.hostActive: Theme disabled / restoring · Controller remains active
messages.status.restoring: Restoring native appearance and stopping the theme…
messages.status.clientKept: The official client was not closed.
messages.status.notSaved: Language choice was not saved. Check file permissions.
messages.status.localePending: Manager language updated; theme controls are awaiting synchronization.
messages.status.localeSynced: Interface language synchronized; this does not indicate the theme is enabled.
messages.status.corruptConfig: Optional settings are invalid; the original file is preserved and safe defaults are used.
messages.status.localMigration: Local migration was saved; client launch and theme application were not requested.
messages.status.externalPending: The request was sent; the final result is unconfirmed.
messages.status.localChange: Local changes were saved; the final result is unconfirmed.
messages.restoration.lease_pending: Theme process stopped; appearance awaits lease cleanup and is unconfirmed
messages.restoration.unknown: Theme process stopped; current page appearance is unconfirmed
messages.confirm.enable: Enable the theme in the dedicated official window? On first use, sign in and retry. See the bundled User Notice for details.
messages.confirm.rights: Do you have permission to use the selected imported assets? Import stops the current theme.
messages.confirm.remove: Remove this asset pack? If it is selected, the built-in assets for that category will be restored first.
messages.picker.resources: Choose a resource ZIP you may use
messages.diagnostic.title: Diagnostic summary
messages.diagnostic.generic: Operation could not be confirmed. Code: {code}
messages.diagnostic.failed: The operation did not complete. See original diagnostics.
messages.pack.title: Silver-Scale Atelier · Characters and scenes
messages.pack.summary: Select characters and scenes independently. Four states are static poses, not continuous animation.
messages.pack.busy: Wait for the current asset operation to finish.
messages.menu.focusHidden: Focus mode hides decorations and keeps the selected level
messages.menu.sharedDensity: Home and chat share and remember this level
messages.menu.noCharacters: No character packs imported. Import one in the manager.
messages.menu.resourceUnavailable: Some environment assets are unavailable; available layers are retained.
messages.menu.characterUnavailable: Character switch did not complete; the current character is retained.
messages.theme.heroDescription: Give every curiosity a quiet space to unfold.
messages.theme.bannerTitle: Leave a little quiet for thoughts taking shape.
messages.error.deadline: The operation timed out; its final state needs verification.
messages.error.helper_failed: The local helper could not confirm the operation. See original diagnostics.
messages.error.helper_timeout: The local helper timed out; the result is not confirmed.
messages.error.identity: Process or session identity could not be verified. State was preserved without automatic takeover.
messages.error.clientChanged: Client identity or version changed; the theme will not load.
messages.error.unsupportedClient: This client version is unverified; theme loading is blocked.
messages.error.capability: The page lacks verified structural requirements; the theme will not modify it.
messages.error.foreignSession: The page belongs to another theme session. Wait for that session to exit normally.
messages.error.reconcile: Reconcile the unconfirmed operation first. The request was not repeated.
messages.error.state: Local state could not be verified; original files were preserved.
messages.error.lock: Exclusive ownership of the operation is unconfirmed. Check again.
messages.error.startup: Startup was not confirmed within the time limit. Check diagnostics.
messages.error.stop: Theme shutdown is unconfirmed; the official client was not closed.
messages.error.pack: The asset operation did not complete. Check asset validation diagnostics.
messages.error.invalidRequest: The request is invalid or this feature is not enabled in the first release.
messages.error.rebind: No verified connection is ready. Use Reverify connection.
messages.error.cleanup: Cleanup was not fully confirmed; relevant files were retained for inspection.
messages.error.ownerEnded: The previous owner ended. Its result remains unconfirmed; new requests are now allowed.
messages.error.protocol: The helper returned no verifiable result. Keep the diagnostics.
messages.status.rebound: The existing dedicated connection was reverified. You may apply the theme.
messages.status.reconciled: The original operation's final confirmation was found.
messages.port.listening: Local listener only; closes when the dedicated client exits normally
messages.pack.builtinLicense: The original artwork retains its existing source information. Redistribution rights have not been verified.
messages.menu.characterPending: Preparing the selected assets. You can keep choosing; the latest selection wins.
messages.menu.characterOff: The theme is off. Your selection is saved; the character remains hidden.
messages.menu.characterFocus: Focus mode hides the character and keeps your selection.
messages.menu.characterKeep: Apply a character while keeping the current scene, theme and environment detail.
messages.error.uiSync: Theme-control language synchronization is unconfirmed; the current theme state is preserved.
messages.status.localeFailed: Language choice saved, but synchronization failed. Check diagnostics and retry.
